title: What Color Is It? A Text-Interference Multimodal Hallucination Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models using a custom dataset of images with conflicting textual semantics and visual color attributes (e.g., the word 'blue' written in red ink) to measure the models' over-reliance on textual information over visual evidence (often referred to as 'blind faith in text').
